note: Roles are stable ids; providers are separate entries. Production routing is NOT enabled: every assignment is null, so nothing is routed unless a caller names a provider explicitly. A provider entry may not declare permissions or tools — those belong to the role.

architect.description: architecture review / acceptance on a context pack; answers in text

worker.description: implementation worker — through THIS contract only a text answer on a context pack; code changes stay outside the contract

claude_subscription_cli.description: existing approved seam: the local Claude Code CLI on the owner's subscription (`claude -p`, tools disabled, no MCP), as in spa_core/studio_os/memory/answer.py

fixture_test_adapter.description: TEST adapter: deterministic canned answers from a fixture file; exercises the same contract; it is NOT a second provider and never production
